name: pattern_edit_undo
title: Pattern in Edit: note, instrument, volume and FX of a step by pads and encoder, undo to the empty journal, redo to the empty stack, undo again (nothing saved)

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)
(Rec toggles Browse <-> Edit: only when it is in Browse)
(redo on an empty journal says NOTHING TO REDO: it makes the last message a known one)
(soft: the journal is empty after a load)
E1: a pad enters a note (and the cursor moves on by JUMP)
(soft: JUMP may be 0 in this project)
E2: the encoder raises the note of the step by 3 semitones
E3: a pad in the INSTR column picks instrument pad + 1 (here 5) and writes no note of its own (OS-AUDIT E-PAT-12; one undo unit)
E4: a pad in the VOL column enters a volume
E5: a pad in an FX column enters an FX value
E6: Fx held + the encoder is the FX type (soft: it depends on the held-encoder gesture)

steps.say: undo: the first F8 must not say NOTHING TO UNDO (an edit is in the journal), then F8 is pressed until it does (at most 120 times: the history may hold more than this scenario's edits)

steps.note: the journal is empty (drained by the until above, whatever else the history held: mutes, sample edits): every edit of this scenario is undone

steps.say: redo: one redo must work (the last message stays NOTHING TO UNDO), then the redo stack is drained

steps.note: a redo that worked says nothing
and undone again: the pattern is back as loaded, nothing was saved

finally.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
